answer: Issue only a fixed number of challenge submissions each epoch and auction the slots. A farm wanting N heads to submit must outbid honest agents N times, bidding against its own demand — the farm's scale becomes the clearing price it pays for every head. Slot-holding concentrates like hulls at a wharf: the auction ledger exposes which bidders cluster, so a farm operating in the ocean of honest agents stands out as a single onyx-bright blot of correlated bids, and one overpaid slot detonates the margin for all of them.
